narrative.intro: Reed Technology and Information Services has $218M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Reed Technology received 1 award this fiscal year, with an average award size of $218M, and obligations are up 27.0% year over year. Reed Technology obligations rose from $175M in FY21 to $185M in FY22, $198M in FY23, $199M in FY24, and then fell to $172M in FY25 before reaching $218M in FY26. The FY2026 total is a partial, fiscal year to date figure. This profile summarizes award counts, average award size, and the last six fiscal years of obligations so contracting officers and industry analysts can see recent scale and year-to-year movement in Reed Technology federal business.
